title: Shimmer Button
description: CTA button with a continuous light sweep.

a11y.motion: The sweep is off; a faint static sheen rests on the right side of the button. The hover scale still applies.
a11y.keyboard: Native <button>: reachable with Tab, activated with Enter or Space, and focus-visible shows a 2px outline in the ring colour.
a11y.screenReader: Named by its children; the shimmer overlay is aria-hidden.
